# AsterDEX

> AsterDEX is a non-custodial exchange on BNB Chain offering spot and perpetual trading settled on-chain, with the ASTER token. This page is an interface where you connect your own wallet and sign every transaction. It explains spot versus perpetual markets, costs and risks.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- AsterDEX is a decentralized exchange on BNB Chain with spot and perpetual markets.
- Trades settle on-chain from the user's own wallet.
- Perpetuals add margin, funding payments and liquidation risk compared with spot.
- Gas on BNB Chain is paid in BNB; trading fees are shown before signing.
- ASTER is a separate token and is not required to trade.

## Pages

- AsterDEX & learn: https://asterdex-app.github.io/
- Legal: https://asterdex-app.github.io/legal.html
